summary: The emote catalogue, and which gesture each slot of this player's wheel plays. All gestures are the game's animations. The layout is kept on this machine for the session, and resources there share one wheel.

getCatalog.summary: The emotes in catalogue order, each with its animation: fragment and tags, plus femaleTags where a woman's body differs. To play one on an NPC, call npc.playAnimation(fragment, { tags }) on the server.
getCatalog.returns: { id: number; name: string; duration: number; fullBody: boolean; fragment: string; tags: string; femaleTags: string }[]
getCatalog.exampleLua:
-- client
local bow = nil
for _, emote in ipairs(kcds.ui.EmoteWheel.getCatalog()) do
  if emote.name == "Bow" then
    bow = emote
    break
  end
end
if bow then
  kcds.core.Events.toServer("mannequinEmote", bow.fragment, bow.tags)
end

slotTotal.summary: The number of slots, which is 6.

getSlots.summary: The catalogue id in each slot, clockwise from straight up.

assignSlot.summary: Puts an emote in one slot. With a bad slot or id it returns false and changes nothing.

params.slot: The slot: 0 is straight up, continuing clockwise.

assignSlot.example: kcds.ui.EmoteWheel.assignSlot(5, 8); // the last slot now points
assignSlot.exampleLua: kcds.ui.EmoteWheel.assignSlot(5, 8) -- the last slot now points
assignSlot.exampleCs: EmoteWheel.AssignSlot(5, 8); // the last slot now points

assignSlots.summary: Sets all slots together. With a wrong length or bad id it returns false and changes nothing.

reset.summary: Restores the default six: wave, big wave, nod, respectful nod, bow and cheer.
